operations.label: Measure the temperature series
operations.description: Characterize at 0, −5, −10, −15, −20, −25 and −30 °C. Section 2.3 gives a general 12 h hold before next-day measurements; separate Figure 4 hold times are not restated. Figure 4 curve a shows absorption only at −30 °C; b–h are the seven fluorescence temperatures.

operations.label: Test five heating and cooling cycles
operations.description: Repeatedly heat to 0 °C and cool to −30 °C five times and measure fluorescence. Ramp rates, hold times per cycle and the chronological initial endpoint are not specified. Do not assign the general 12 h characterization hold to each cycle.

measurements.conditions: 0 °C baseline = 100%; 30% ethanol dispersion. Main p.1 abstract states fluorescence increases about 62–82% from 0 to −30 °C. Main p.5 and Figure 5A instead give 162, 147, 135 and 122% of the original for 1–4 h QDs. These source statements are retained separately; the abstract range is not assigned to any individual sample.

quality.review_scope: All seven main pages, preparation variants and linked figures. Proposed delivery metadata requires exact independent full scoped acceptance before integration; audit is pending.
missing_fields: No sample-specific atomic coordinates, crystal phase, unit cell, facet indices or surface coverage are reported.
No unprinted graph coordinates are digitized. Source plots retain the measured evidence.
QD concentration, isolated yield, storage, exact physical-batch joins, unreported stock composition and equipment settings remain unassigned.
Per-cycle dwell times, thermal ramp rates and fluorescence excitation wavelength are unreported.
conflicts: Main p.1 abstract states fluorescence increases about 62–82% from 0 to −30 °C. Main p.5 and Figure 5A instead give 162, 147, 135 and 122% of the original for 1–4 h QDs. These source statements are retained separately; the abstract range is not assigned to any individual sample.
Section 3.4 heading says temperature dependence at 0 °C; its body and figures explicitly cover 0 to −30 °C.
